title: finance-legal personal todo - invoices & renewals
content:
Daily scratchpad - finance/legal personal todo

Quick context:
- Catch-all scratchpad for small finance/legal follow-ups I need to handle or track.
- Mostly invoice checks, contract redlines, renewal reminders and ad-hoc vendor questions.
- Not comprehensive; moved items to Confluence or JIRA when they become workstreams.

TODAY (high priority):
- Invoice: Vendor: DataLabs Inc. — INV-2026-0117 (due 2026-03-07)
  - Confirm PO match: PO-2256 submitted by Ops 2026-02-20
  - AP notes: unit pricing differs from contract appendix B. Flag for procurement.
  - Action: Email procurement + cc Maya by EOD 2026-03-02 (subject: DataLabs INV mismatch)

- Contract redline: Managed Service Agreement (AlphaSecure) renewal
  - Renewal window: 2026-04-15 auto-renew unless notice given.
  - Key asks: limit indemnity to direct damages, add SOC2 attestation clause, tighten data retention purge period from 90 -> 30 days.
  - Current status: received counter from vendor 2026-02-28, tracked in CONFLUENCE-1234.
  - Action: Draft response with proposed redlines; run past Ethan for risk tolerance. Target: send 2026-03-05.

- Renewal reminder: CloudStorage provider (annual)
  - Contract: CS-2024-01, renews 2026-03-31.
  - Spend: ~ $12k/month. Evaluate Dedicated vs Marketplace pricing before renewal.
  - Action: Quick cost analysis (2 scenarios) and recommendation by 2026-03-15.

LOWER PRIORITY / catch-up:
- Invoice backlog: check AP queue for any >30d outstanding (weekly sweep)
  - Last sweep: 2026-02-25. Add to calendar: recurring task Monday mornings.

- NDA request: Sales shared one-pager, contact: Martina (Partner A)
  - Need redline to restrict demo data use.
  - Action: simple clause to add to standard NDA template; send draft to sales by 2026-03-09.

NOTES / QUESTIONS:
- How strict do we want on vendor PO matching for small vendors (< $5k)? Ops asked to relax for speed; need policy note. (Follow up with Procurement)
- Who has final signatory for <$50k SaaS renewals? Last chart said VP Finance, but Sales told me Head of Product signs for certain categories. Clarify.

SHORT-LIVED REMINDERS (scratch):
- Chase invoice INV-2026-0109 (Stripe fee dispute) — status: waiting on vendor reply (2026-02-28)
- Add line item for contract with TranslateX: usage-based clause needs cap
- Ask SRE for SOC2 attestation date for AlphaSecure — Ethan owns follow-up

REFERENCE LINKS / ARTIFACTS:
- Confluence: vendor-contracts/alpha-secure (CONFLUENCE-1234)
- JIRA: FINOPS-6789 (follow-up tasks for invoice mismatches)
- GitHub PR: contracts/pull/45 (NDA template tweaks)

TODDLER LIST (move to JIRA when ready):
- Create vendor scoring doc for procurement (template + metrics)
- Renewal calendar for next 90 days (visible to Finance + Legal)

END NOTES / PERSONAL:
- Keep this doc light; copy anything actionable to Confluence or create a JIRA with clear owner + due.
- If urgent, ping on Slack #fin-legal with subject line prefix [URGENT].

Last quick log: 2026-03-02 09:15 AM — Added DataLabs invoice + redline due dates.
